_about: Which profiles each project has. Keys are paths relative to the root ('.' is the root itself). Example entry: "my-api": {"profiles": ["lang-python", "secure-code"], "notes": "Handles sensitive data."}. 'recommended' lists profiles to suggest; 'inline' holds one-off exceptions (plugins_on, plugins_off, connectors_on, connectors_off), which /ntk flags, so prefer a profile. /project-setup adds entries for you.
